R721_nontrivial_extension_or_equivariant: Every faithful nontrivial finite-group extension or equivariantization of an AH category has dimension |G|*(136+32*sqrt17), hence differs from R721. Morita duals preserve this dimension. This does not classify de-equivariantizations, modified constructions, or categories outside the known family.
